hospital_coding_system_help: Binds this hospital to one diagnosis code catalogue (WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, or WHO ICD-11). Cannot change after coded diagnoses exist.

icd_who_attribution: Ebirimu mu ICD-10 ne ICD-11 bya ddembe ly’okukozesa ekitongole ky’ebyobulamu mu nsi yonna (WHO). ICD-11 erina layisinsi wansi wa CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Okukozesa kyetaagisa okuwandiika; okukyusakyusa mu mbeera zeetaaga olukusa okuva mu WHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Each hospital binds one diagnosis coding catalogue (WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, or WHO ICD-11 MMS) at create time. EMR diagnosis search uses that catalog only. WHO catalogs import via WHO ICD-API; ICD-10-CM imports from CDC code description files. Each edition stays in its own system column.

prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Teekawo engeri koodi z’abalwadde, ennamba z’okukyalira, n’ennamba z’okulagira empeereza gye zizimbibwamu. Buli kigendererwa kikozesa ekisumuluzo ky’enkola ekinywevu; okyusa ennyonyola n'ensengeka yokka.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Ekozesebwa nga bawandiisa abalwadde abapya. Ekika ky'okukyalira tekiriwo ku koodi eno.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Ekozesebwa ku buli mulwadde okukyalira; mulimu ekika ky’ettabi n’okukyalira ng’ennimiro ezo ziri mu nkola.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Ekozesebwa nga okola orders z'obuweereza. Enkola esookerwako ekwatagana ne YY/visit/NNN. Ggyako “Separate sequence per visit” kale ennamba z’okulagira zibalire 001, 002... buli mulwadde okukyalira (ekisemba). Bwe kiba nga kizikiddwa, omutendera gugabanyizibwa ku biragiro byonna ebikozesa ensengeka za sikopu endala ze zimu.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Ekozesebwa nga okola ebiwandiiko ebisaba okugula (PR). Kino kitegeke nga abakozi tebannakola PR.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Ekozesebwa nga okola ebiragiro by’okugula (PO). Kino kitegeke nga abakozi tebannakola PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Ekozesebwa nga okola indents z’ekitongole. Kino kitegeke nga abakozi tebannakola indents.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Ekozesebwa nga okola ensonga z’ekitongole okuva mu masekkati okutuuka ku kusaba amaduuka.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Ekozesebwa nga owaayo ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku nkozesa y’ekitongole okukkirizibwa.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Ekozesebwa nga otereka ebiragiro by’eddagala ery’omunda. Ennyiriri zonna mu save emu zigabana ennamba eno eya batch. Default ekozesa omwaka gw'ebyensimbi, eddwaaliro, n'omutendera ogudduka.

inv_grn_api_hint: Tonda GRNs nga oyita mu POST ne poId, storeId (wakati), receivedDate, ne layini. Buli layini: poLineId, purchasedQty (nga tobaliddeemu bwereere), batchNo, expiryDate, purchasePrice (kyetaagisa nga ekintu kirina okulondoola batch). Ebibinja biba bya bulijjo (item_batch); sitooka eri ku buli dduuka ne batch (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Tegeka emitendera gy'okukkiriza n'abaweebwa ekika ky'edduuka n'ekiwandiiko ky'olonze waggulu.
inv_po_list_empty: Tewali biragiro bya kugula n'okutuusa kati.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Ebivudde mu kunoonya mulimu ku mukono ku dduuka erirondeddwa (okuva) lyokka (issue unit nga liriwo).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: View eggulawo lisiiti eno ku lupapula lwayo; Back ekomawo wano (si ku nsonga ya Department).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Ennyiriri ziri `inv_stock` ezigattibwa ku `item_batch`, nga ziragiddwa okuggwaako (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Sengula ebibinja by'abakozesa okusinziira ku mannya oba id...
inv_user_groups_no_filter_match: Tewali bibinja bya bakozesa bikwatagana na ffilta eno.
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Yingiza obungi obukkiriziddwa buli layini bwe buba nga bulina okwawukana ku busabiddwa. Pending PR qty egatta layini ezikwatagana okuva mu dduuka lino erisaba (erindiriddwa, esindikiddwa emabega, oba ekkiriziddwa), omuli n'okusaba kuno.
inv_pr_approve_logs_empty: Tewali byafaayo bya kukkiriza n’okutuusa kati.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Tewali bintu bikyaliwo. Nywa ku + okugattako ekintu, olwo Teeka order.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Londa okusaba okugula okukkirizibwa waggulu. Emmeeza ejja kutikka wano ne buli layini: ekintu, yuniti (Item Unit Master conversion), obungi obusigadde, obungi bwa order, ne unit price.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Sooka olonde ekintu, olwo olonde yuniti (okukyusa) okuva ku lukalala lw’ekintu ekyo Item Unit Master.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Ekintu kino tekirina nkyukakyuka za yuniti ezikola. Zitegeke wansi w’okuteekawo Inventory → Item master.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Londa edduuka erigula ebintu erya wakati mu bbaala eri waggulu. Ebiragiro ebikkirizibwa eby’okugula ekiragiro ekipya biwandiikibwa nga dduuka eryo lirondeddwa: bisindikibwa mu maduuka amalala nga edduuka ly’eddagala eritali CPS etegekeddwa.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Tegeka edduuka ly’okugula ery’omu makkati wansi w’okuteekawo Inventory → Hospital inventory config nga tonnaba kutondawo biragiro bya kugula okuva mu requisitions.

Mu Inventory setup, ssaako akabonero ku store emu ddala buli ttabi nga central (ye central store), olwo ogezeeko nate.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Londa order y’okugula olabe dduuka erifuna.

inv_issue_batch_optional: Batch (eky’okwesalirawo, FEFO bwe kiba nga njereere)

inv_pr_trace_hint: Layini bw’eba mu bujjuvu ku order(s) y’okugula, obungi obuggule buba 0 wano; track ordered, received, era nga ekyalina okufunibwa ku screens za PO ne GRN.
inv_pr_trace_empty_po: Tewali biragiro bya kugula bikwatagana n’okutuusa kati.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Orders z'okugula ziriwo ku PR eno naye olukalala terwasobodde kutikka. Gezaako okuzza obuggya omuko.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Ebbaala ey’okungulu eteeka yinvensulo yo / okusaba (okuva mu) dduuka. Olukalala lulaga requisitions ezireeteddwa dduuka eryo. Londa Amaduuka gonna okulaba okusaba okuva mu buli dduuka erisaba, oba kozesa omusengejja gw'ennyiriri z'amaduuka okufunza okuva ku dduuka.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Sitooki ekoma ku dduuka eriri mu bbaala ey’okungulu. Londa Amaduuka gonna olabe buli dduuka mu ddwaaliro.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Olukalala lukoma ku nnyiriri ezisituddwa dduuka mu bbaala ey’okungulu. Londa All stores okulaba indents zonna ez'ekitongole.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Tonda okusaba okugula okuva mu dduuka erisaba (ebbaala ey’okungulu) → oluvannyuma lw’okukkirizibwa, tonda ekiragiro ky’okugula era oteeke GRN mu dduuka erifuna → ku lukalala lwa GRN, kozesa Transfer okutambuza sitooka efunibwa mu dduuka eryaggulawo okusaba (nga PR eyungiddwa ku PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Okuva mu dduuka kuva mu bbaala ey’okungulu. Londa To store ku requisition eno.
inv_flow_po_context: POs z’edduuka erirondeddwa (ebbaala ey’okungulu) zigoberera ebiwandiiko ebikkirizibwa okugula oba okuyingira mu ngalo; okukkiriza olwo n’osindika eri omugabi nga ebyamaguzi tebinnaba kufuna.
inv_flow_grn_context: Teeka lisiiti mu dduuka erifuna (ebbaala ey’okungulu). PO bw’eyungiddwa ku requisition, kozesa Transfer okusindika sitooka mu dduuka erisaba oluvannyuma lw’okuteeka GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Londa dduuka mu bbaala waggulu okussa essira ku lukalala luno, oba kozesa All purchase orders mu ddwaaliro nga tewali dduuka lirondeddwa.

inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Central store (top bar = From store) ereeta ensonga ku maduuka agasaba: oba okuva mu indent y’ekitongole ekkiriziddwa nga erindirira okutuukirira, oba mu ngalo awatali indent.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Okufaananako n’ebiragiro by’okugula: kozesa New okuva mu kitongole indent nga sitooka esabiddwa mu dduuka lyo erya wakati ng’oyita mu indent; kozesa Manual nga tewali indent.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Kyusa ekifuga “Okuva mu dduuka” mu bbaala ey’okungulu (okumpi n’ettabi / ekibinja ky’abakozesa) ng’ekitundu kya Inventory kiggule.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Indents zino zikkirizibwa dduuka erisaba era zikulinze okuggulawo ensonga y’ekitongole. Londa dduuka eriri wakati mu bbaala eri waggulu.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Tonda ensonga y’ekitongole okuva mu Inventory → Ensonga y’ekitongole → Empya okuva mu indent y’ekitongole (edduuka erya wakati lirina okukwatagana n’edduuka lya indent eno “to” mu bbaala ey’okungulu).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Londa sitoowa eya wakati (etuukiriza) mu bbaala ey’okungulu. Olukalala lulaga ensonga nga sitoowa eyo y’efulumya (Okuva).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Kiriza lisiiti ku dduuka lyo erisaba (okuva mu bbaala). Indents ezifulumiziddwa zirabika wano okutuusa nga zifunibwa.
inv_di_cancel_reason_prompt: Yingiza ensonga lwaki osazaamu indent eno.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Londa sitoowa yo gy’osaba mu bbaala ey’okungulu okuwandiika ebiwandiiko ebiyingiziddwa mu dduuka eryo.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Wandiika enkozesa mu dduuka ng’olina okuggyibwako ku ddaala lya batch. Waayo okukkirizibwa; final approval posts enkozesa era ekendeeza ku sitooka.
inv_dc_list_scope_hint: Olukalala luno lusobola okugoberera dduuka mu bbaala eri waggulu oba okulaga amaduuka gonna.
inv_dc_configure_dc_approvers: Tegeka abakkiriza okukozesa ekitongole (module DC) ku dduuka lino mu Inventory Setup → Approval configuration.

inv_dc_batch_qty_exceeds_stock: Omuwendo gusukka sitooka eriwo ku batch emu oba eziwera.
medication_order_external_sales_empty: Ekigaali kiri bwereere. Okwongerako ebintu ku kkono.

med_order_batch_pick_help: Yingiza obungi buli batch (purchase unit). Omugatte gukwatagana n'ennimiro y'obungi bwa layini.

med_order_int_past_start: Olunaku lw’okutandika teruyinza kuba nga leero terunnatuuka.
med_order_int_draft_empty: Ku lukalala yongerako waakiri layini emu.

med_order_int_update_failed: Okulongoosa kulemereddwa. Kebera obubaka bwa seva era ogezeeko nate.
med_order_int_saved: Ekiragiro ky'eddagala kiterekeddwa. Ennamba ya batch empya yaweebwa.
med_order_int_delete_confirm: Ssaako batch yonna ne layini zaayo zonna? Kino tekiyinza kuggyibwawo.
med_order_int_no_batches: Tewali biragiro bya ddagala biterekeddwa ku kukyala kuno.
med_order_int_editing: Okulongoosa order eterekeddwa: enkyukakyuka zikola ku Update.
med_order_int_reorder_stagger_aria: Tonda order empya eterekeddwa (batch empya) okuva ku layini esooka eya order eno. Obudde bw’okutandika buba oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekisembayo eky’okumaliriza ku kukyala kuno, oba okuva kati singa ekyo kyandibadde mu biseera eby’emabega.
med_order_int_reorder_append_confirm: Teeka order empya n’ennamba ya batch empya, ng’okozesa layini esooka eya order eno? Obudde bw'okutandika buteekebwawo oluvannyuma lwa layini yo eyasooka okuggwa. Osigala mu lukalala lw’ebyafaayo.
med_order_int_reorder_line_appended: Order empya yaterekebwa nga erina ennamba ya batch empya.
med_order_int_starts_staggered_toast: Ebiseera by’okutandika bigoberera ensengeka ya layini. Buli layini etandika oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekijjuvu ekya layini eyasooka. Emirundi ne ddoozi tebikyuka.
inv_pr_create_disabled_store_not_requisi: Store eno tesobola kukola requisitions z’okugula. Ggulawo okugula okwetaagisa mu Store Master.
home_inv_dashboard_subtitle: Okulambika ku bunene bw’ettabi obulondeddwa mu bbaala y’okutambulirako.
home_inv_dashboard_stock_alerts_hint: Okubala kuzingiramu amaduuka gokka agali mu matabi g’olonze. Okulabula mu app ne email zisindikibwa buli dduuka ly’owandiise, era nga ya njawulo ku sitooka entono vs eggwaako mu bbanga ttono (yongera buli dduuka wansi w’okuteekawo Inventory → Stock alerts).

inv_reorder_level_subtitle: Teekawo emitendera egy’ebintu ebitono buli dduuka n’ekintu.
inv_reorder_level_min_qty_conversion_hin: Yingiza obungi obutono mu yuniti z’okugula; kiterekebwa nga obungi bwa sitokisi (efulumya) nga tukozesa okukyusa erongooseddwa.
inv_stock_alert_subtitle: Londa sitoowa buli muntu gy’alondoola, n’okwongerako okukyusakyusa email n’eddirisa erisookerwako eriggwaako-mu bbanga ttono.
inv_stock_alert_policy_hint: Amadirisa agaggwaako buli kintu gasobola okuteekebwa ku Item Master (ekyusakyusa eddwaliro ekisookerwako wansi).
inv_stock_alert_policy_email_channels: Okulabula mu app kugoberera obubonero bw'Abaweebwa bwokka. Okufuna ne emails, ssaako buli kika kya alert wano (ekiterekeddwa), sengeka SMTP ku server, era okakasa nti buli omukozi’s Better Auth login alina email address.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_days: Ennaku eziggwaako-mu bbanga ttono zirina okuba wakati wa 1 ne 365.
inv_stock_alert_recipients_hint: Buli lunyiriri lulina dduuka limu n’omukozi omu. Okulabula kukwata ku sitoowa ya dduuka eryo yokka: kwataganya ekitundu kya Store ku lipoota y’ebintu ebitono. Kozesa obubonero bwa Low stock / Expiring soon buli lunyiriri; Enkola nayo erina enkyukakyuka za email ez’enjawulo. Abakozi abaweereddwa amalwaliro bokka be basobola okwongerwako.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: Omukozi oyo yawandiikibwa dda ku dduuka lino.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: Okufuna okulabula mu budde ne email, kuba enkomerero eno ku nteekateeka (e.g. buli ddakiika 15). Kozesa email=1 yokka nga SMTP etegekeddwa.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Sindika omutwe Olukusa: Omusitula <CRON_SECRET> oba x-cron-secret. Teeka CRON_SECRET mu mbeera ya seva.
inv_store_markup_percent_invalid: Store markup erina okuba wakati wa 0 ne 999.
inv_pricing_template_subtitle: Enkola z’emiwendo gy’okutunda eziddamu okukozesebwa (MSL, bendera z’omuwendo). Gabira ku ttabi ne modulo ku nsengeka y'emiwendo.
inv_pricing_assignment_subtitle: Londa ekifaananyi kimu eky’ensengekera buli ttabi ne modulo y’okutunda. Entambula z’okutunda n’okugaba zikozesa ekifaananyi ekiweereddwa mu kiseera ky’okutunda.
inv_pricing_assignment_unassigned_warnin: Tewali template eweereddwa: okutunda kwa module eno ku ttabi lino kujja kulemererwa okutuusa nga ogaba emu.
inv_pricing_assignment_overview_subtitle: Ensengekera ki ekwata ku buli ddwaaliro, ettabi, ne modulo.
inv_pricing_config_subtitle: Gabira ekifaananyi ky’ensengekera buli ttabi ne modulo y’okutunda (okutunda okw’omunda, okutunda okw’ebweru, enkozesa y’ekitongole).
inv_pricing_config_branch_locked_hint: Okukozesa ettabi okuva ku bbaala y'okutambulirako: {branch}. Londa “All Branches” mu nav okulonda ettabi ery’enjawulo wano.
inv_pricing_config_manual_on_grn: Okuyingira mu ngalo ku buli layini ya GRN
inv_pricing_config_sale_help_manual: Yingiza omuwendo gw'okutunda ku buli layini ya GRN ng'oteeka.
inv_pricing_config_emp_percent: Ebitundu ku kikumi ku bbeeyi y’okutunda
inv_pricing_config_emp_use_percent_of_sa: Kozesa ebitundu ku kikumi eby’ebbeeyi y’okutunda (simbira ekkuuli enkyukakyuka z’omuwendo wansi)
inv_pricing_config_emp_help_manual: Yingiza omuwendo gw’okutunda kw’omukozi ku buli layini ya GRN ng’oteeka.
inv_pricing_config_formula_denom_purchas: yaguliddwa qty + ya bwereere qty (okugula yuniti) .

inv_pricing_preview_hint: Ebalirirwa okuva mu nsengekera ewereddwa mu kiseera ky'okutunda (teterekebwa ku kibinja).
inv_pricing_preview_unavailable: Teyasobodde kubalirira kusooka kulaba bbeeyi. Kebera okugaba modulo n'enkolagana ya batch GRN.
item_master_item_markup_percent_hint: Okwesalirawo. Ekozesebwa mu kifo kya ITEM nga obalirira omuwendo gw’okutunda ku dispense oba billing.
item_master_item_markup_percent_invalid: Item markup erina okuba wakati wa 0 ne 999.
inv_store_markup_percent_hint: Okwesalirawo. Ekozesebwa mu kifo kya STORE nga obala omuwendo gw’okutunda okuva mu dduuka lino.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_hint: Kya kusalawo. Nga wabulayo ennaku okuggwaako okussaako bendera ku looti nga eziggwaako mu bbanga ttono. Leka nga njereere okukozesa eddwaliro default okuva mu Stock alerts.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_inval: Yingiza ennamba enzijuvu wakati wa 1 ne 365, oba leka nga tewali kintu kyonna.

home_seo_title: Omuyimbi Medora | Emirimu gy’eddwaliro egy’obukkakkamu eri buli ttiimu y’abalabirira
home_seo_description: Medora ye EMR ey’amalwaliro amangi ey’okwewandiisa, okukyalira, okukola emirimu gy’obujjanjabi, okuwandiika ebintu, n’okuddukanya. Console emu eya Medora eri bannannyini yo, abakozi, n’okulabirira wansi.
home_hero_headline: Ennaku z’eddwaaliro zifuule okutambula okukkakkamu, okukwatagana
home_hero_body: Medora: emirimu gy’okulabirira amalwaliro amangi nga mulimu okwewandiisa, okukyalira, entebe z’okukoleramu mu malwaliro, n’okutereka ebintu mu kifo kimu eky’abapangisa.
home_how_heading: Okuva ku kwewandiisa okutuuka ku kulambula okuggaddwa
home_how_lead: Flow emu eri walk-ins ne booked care. Built for the moments ttiimu mu butuufu zitambuza abalwadde.
home_how_step1_body: Wamba endagamuntu, alergy, n’ebyafaayo omulundi gumu. Buli lwe bakyalira oluvannyuma kuddamu okukozesa ekipande kye kimu.
home_how_step2_body: Tonda okukyalira OP oba IP, ssaako appointments, era okukuuma embeera y’amatabi nga ntegeerevu ku mwaliiro.
home_how_step3_body: Nursing vitals, diagnoses, medication orders, n’ebiwandiiko bibeera ku timeline y’emu ey’okukyalira.
home_how_step4_body: Ensonga z’ebintu, okugaba ebisale, n’emitendera gy’okusiibulwa bisigala nga bikwatagana ne likoda y’okukyalira.
home_modules_lead: Capability packs zibikka ku mmeeza ezirina okusigala nga zikwatagana: front office, clinical floors, stores, ne admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Patient master, okutondawo okukyalira, okusisinkana, n’okukebera amatabi.
home_modules_clinical_body: Module za nnansi n‟okwebuuza nga zirina ebikulu, okuzuula, ebiragiro, n‟ebiwandiiko bya EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Amaduuka, ebitundu, PR/PO/GRN, enkozesa y’ekitongole, n’okulabula ku sitoowa.
home_modules_admin_body: Abakozi, amatabi, ebibinja by’abakozesa, masters, ebiwandiiko, n’okuteekawo eddwaaliro.
home_model_heading: SaaS emu. Amalwaliro mangi. Emirimu egy’enjawulo.
home_model_lead: Medora ya malwaliro mangi mu ngeri gye yategekebwamu. Omukutu guno gwe gutondawo eddwaaliro. Eddwaaliro lye liddukanya okulabirira. Abalwadde tebeetaaga ofiisi yo ey’emabega.
home_model_platform_body: System admins bannannyini nsigo, amalwaliro, n'ebikuumi buli mupangisa by'agabana.
home_model_hospital_body: Bannannyini n’abaddukanya bategeka amatabi, amaduuka, okuyingira kw’abakozi, ne bakama.
home_model_staff_body: Ba nurse, abasawo, ne ttiimu z’amaduuka bakola okuva mu modulo ezimanyi emirimu ku wansi.
home_model_patients_body: Chati, okukyalira, n’ebiwandiiko bisigala mu ddwaaliro; abakozi baweereza okuva ku console.
home_surfaces_heading: Surfaces for buli role ku wansi
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Vitals, allergies, nursing notes, n’emirimu gy’oku kitanda nga tovudde mu kukyala.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Okuzuula, okulagira eddagala, n’ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku bujjanjabi ku mmeeza y’omusawo.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Okufuna, okufulumya, okukyusa, n’okubala sitooka n’okumanyisa batch n’okuggwaako.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Abakozi, amatabi, ebibinja by’okuyingira, abakugu mu biwandiiko, n’okusengeka.
home_integrated_heading: Buli mmeeza gikuume ku kiseera kimu
home_integrated_lead: Okulonda, eddagala, ebiwandiiko, n’okutambula kwa sitooka bigabana okukyala kale wansi ne gusigala nga gukwatagana.
home_integrated_f5: Okulabula ku sitoowa ne lipoota z’okuggwaako
home_integrated_f6: Ebyafaayo by’okukyalira ebitabo ebikwatagana n’okubala ebitabo
home_cta_heading: Mwetegefu okuggulawo olunaku oluddako mu ddwaaliro
home_cta_body: Yingira mu Medora console, londa eddwaaliro, era otandike okuva ku modules ttiimu yo z'ekozesa edda.
home_footer_tagline: Emirimu gy’eddwaliro okuwandiisa, okulabirira mu malwaliro, okuwandiika ebintu, n’okuddukanya.
home_scene_aria: Medora ekyokulabirako ky'eddwaliro ku mabbali g'emiti mu luggya olukkakkamu
pricing_seo_description: Medora hospital EMR pricing: Ekire okuva ku $99/mo (Okutandika okutuuka ku Platform). On-premise ekozesa tiers ze zimu ku Cloud price + $150/mo okuteeka ku infrastructure yo. Okwewandiisa, clinical, inventory, ne admin.
pricing_lead: Cloud SaaS oba On-premise ku infrastructure yo. Emitendera gya Starter, Business, Scale, ne Platform gye gimu. Sayizi ya malwaliro ne modulo, so si kweraliikirira kwa mita buli kukyalira.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud etegekebwa Medora: SaaS ey’amalwaliro amangi, okulongoosa okuddukanyizibwa, n’ebikozesebwa ebigabanyizibwa ku buli mukutu gw’oddukanya.
pricing_lead_onprem: On-premise ye product tiers ze zimu, eziteekeddwa era ne ziteekebwa ku servers zo, database, ne network. Ggwe nnannyini bikozesebwa. Olukalala lwa buli mwezi luli Cloud + ${premium} olw'obuvunaanyizibwa obwo.
pricing_lead_mmk: Okulaga MMK ku 1 USD = {rate} MMK okugeraageranya mu kitundu.
pricing_lead_usd: USD list prices ku ttiimu z'ensi yonna.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline_onprem: Eddwaaliro erimu Medora ku bikozesebwa byo.
pricing_plan_starter_f3: Entebbe z’emirimu mu ba nnamusa n’okwebuuza ku bantu
pricing_plan_starter_f6: Obuwagizi bwa email n'okulongoosa mu Cloud obutasalako
pricing_plan_starter_f6_onprem: Obuwagizi bwa email; ebipya ku kkubo lyo ery'okufulumya
pricing_plan_business_tagline: Full hospital stack for ttiimu z'okulabirira ezikula.
pricing_plan_business_tagline_onprem: Full hospital stack etekeddwa ku infra yo.

pricing_plan_business_f1_onprem: Amalwaliro agatuuka ku 3 ku bikozesebwa byo

pricing_plan_business_f4: PR / PO / GRN n'okulabula ku sitoowa
pricing_plan_scale_tagline: Multi-hospital Cloud ops nga zirina okugatta.
pricing_plan_scale_tagline_onprem: Multi-hospital ops ku infra yo nga olina integrations.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline: Abaddukanya emirimu nga baddukanya amalwaliro mangi aga Cloud.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline_onprem: Operators abaddukanya amalwaliro mangi ku infra yo.
pricing_plan_platform_f1: Amalwaliro agataliiko kkomo wansi w’omusingi gumu
pricing_plan_platform_f2: Ebifo eby’omugenyi n’eby’okukuba ebitabo ebiriko akabonero akazungu
pricing_plan_platform_f6: Obubaka bw’eddoboozi n’enkola z’okubeera mu data
pricing_plan_platform_f6_onprem: Obubaka mu ddoboozi n’obutuuze obukaluba ku mutimbagano gwo
pricing_who_lead: Platform, eddwaaliro, abakozi, n’abalwadde buli omu afuna omulyango omutangaavu. Londa Cloud oba On-premise, olwo tier y’emu ekwatagana n’amalwaliro ne module mmeka z’oddukanya.
pricing_who_platform_body: Abaddukanya emirimu abasiga amalwaliro mangi era nga beetaaga white-label plus SSO. Londa Platform ku Cloud oba On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Bannannyini n’abaddukanya nga bategeka amatabi, amaduuka, okuyingira kw’abakozi, ne bakama. Business oba Scale ekwatagana n’ebibinja ebisinga obungi ebirimu ebifo bingi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Ba nurse, abasawo, ne ttiimu za sitoowa ku modulo ezimanyi emirimu. Ekkomo ku ntebe scale ne pulaani; abalwadde tebalaba ofiisi ya mabega.
pricing_who_patients_body: Chati, okukyalira, n’ebiwandiiko bisigala mu ddwaaliro. Abakozi baweereza okuva ku console okubuna okwewandiisa okuyita mu close.
pricing_faq_q1: Emiwendo buli kukyala oba buli ntebe y’abakozi?
pricing_faq_a1: Emitendera egyafulumiziddwa giri buli kibinja ky’eddwaliro nga kiriko enkoofiira z’eddwaliro n’entebe. Cloud ne On-premise zigabana Starter, Business, Scale, ne Platform. Olukalala lw’okubeera ku kifo buli mwezi luli Cloud + $150. Tewali mode yonna ekozesa mita ya buli kukyalira egenda essika ku nnaku ezirimu emirimu mingi.
pricing_faq_a2: Okusasula ssente buli mwaka kusibira mu mwaka oguteeberezebwa ogwa Medora. Loomline-style hospital SaaS etera okusasula enteekateeka za buli mwaka nga 15 ku 20%. Medora ekozesa ebitundu 20% ku lukalala lwa buli mwezi ng’osasula buli mwaka, ku byombi Cloud ne On-premise (oluvannyuma lwa +$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_a3: Starter mulimu okwewandiisa okukulu, okukyalira, n’entebe z’okukoleramu mu malwaliro n’ebintu ebikulu. Bizinensi n'okudda waggulu zisumulula enkola z'emirimu gya yinvensulo enzijuvu, ebiragiro by'eddagala ebiyungiddwa ku sitooka, n'okusengeka admin obugagga. Buuza ddi lwe weetaaga eby’okwongerako ebifugibwa.
pricing_faq_a4: Kozesa market toggle waggulu wa pulaani. Global eraga USD yokka. Myanmar eraga MMK ku 1 USD = 5000 MMK (nga USD ye layini ey’okubiri). Ekiseera ky’okusasula ssente n’engeri y’okuweerezaamu byawukana ku katale.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud etegekebwa Medora: SaaS ey’amalwaliro amangi, okulongoosa okuddukanyizibwa, n’okutandika amangu. On-premise ekozesa tiers ze zimu, eziteekeddwa ku infrastructure yo nga weetaaga control oba residency. Infra ye yo; olukalala lwa buli mwezi ye Cloud + $150 ku buvunaanyizibwa obwo.

pricing_trial_error_duration: Londa ebbanga ly’okugezesa: ennaku 7, wiiki 2, oba omwezi 1.
pricing_trial_error_send: Teyasobodde kuweereza kusaba kwo. Gezaako nate oluvannyuma.

admin_icd_subtitle: Browse WHO ICD-10, US ICD-10-CM, and WHO ICD-11 diagnosis codes used by EMR pickers. Each edition is a separate catalogue. Reseed imports the active tab (WHO ICD-API or CDC ICD-10-CM).
admin_icd_empty: No ICD codes match these filters.
admin_icd_reseed_confirm: Import the full catalogue for {system}? This can take a long time. Existing codes are upserted by code so diagnosis links stay valid. WHO editions need WHO_ICD_CLIENT_ID and WHO_ICD_CLIENT_SECRET. ICD-10-CM downloads from CDC.
admin_icd_reseed_success: ICD import finished. Inserted {inserted}, updated {updated}, total {total}.
admin_icd_reseed_hint: WHO tabs walk the WHO ICD-API (ICD-10 2019 / ICD-11 MMS). The ICD-10-CM tab imports CDC order files. Register WHO keys at https://icd.who.int/icdapi. CLI: pnpm db:import:icd -- --system ICD10|ICD11|ICD10_CM|WHO|ALL.
icd_cm_attribution: ICD-10-CM is the US clinical modification published by CDC/NCHS. It is stored as a separate catalogue from WHO ICD-10.
